item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] As jurors deliberate in the Lindsay Clancy trial, here are key moments they may be considering
item.description: PLYMOUTH, Mass. (AP) — Jurors in the closely watched Lindsay Clancy trial began deliberating this week — but had not reached a verdict by the end of the day Friday. They have a lot to consider. Over the past five weeks, the jury heard testimony from doctors, first responders, relatives and even Clancy’s former husband. [...]

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Russian drone strike near Kyiv kills 37 after warehouse explosions
item.description: Zelenskyy blamed possible negligence after a Russian strike on a warehouse near Kyiv left 37 dead and hundreds evacuated.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] First look at Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay released on Netflix ahead of November launch
item.description: A 25-minute teaser previewing GTA 6 dropped on Netflix, offering the first look at the game ahead of its planned November release.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Two killed in motorcycle crash involving pickup truck on US-41 in Hillsborough County: FHP
item.description: Two people died Friday night in a crash involving a pickup truck and two motorcycles at the intersection of U.S. 41 and 24th Avenue South, according to Florida Highway Patrol (FHP).

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] 2 dead in US-41 motorcycle crash in Hillsborough County
item.description: Two people died following a multi-vehicle crash involving two motorcycles and a truck on US-41 in Palm River-Clair Mel on Friday night, according to the Florida Highway Patrol.

item.description: Officials struggled for years to curb high-speed crashes along a residential corridor cutting through Albuquerque, New Mexico, but simply punishing the lead-footed drivers didn’t seem to work. What ultimately did was rewarding the law-abiding ones with fewer red lights. The solution, which the city credits for a dramatic drop in crashes and injuries along one [...]
